Since there is no separate Google review page available for the Rare Rabbit online store or app, I am forced to post this review on the standalone store pages hoping that someone from the brand finally notices this issue and helps resolve my order and refund situation.

I placed an order on the Rare Rabbit app on 10th May 2026 (Order #RCOM2478150), and today is already 22nd May with still no proper resolution from the company. What I received was not the product I had ordered. Instead, I was sent a completely different shirt from another brand altogether. The product came without any price tags, labels, or proper branding and honestly looked like a used item.

What is shocking is not just the wrong delivery, but the complete absence of customer support after that. Multiple emails have been sent to the support team and escalation contacts, yet there has been no proper response, no ownership of the issue, no refund processed, and no movement on the return request which continues to remain stuck as “Pending” on the app.

Calling customer care is pointless because the numbers are either unreachable or nobody responds. At this point, it genuinely feels like customers are left on their own once the payment is made.

This is not the level of service anyone expects from a brand positioning itself as premium. The entire experience has been chaotic, unprofessional, and extremely frustrating.

featured_reviews.name: Gaurav Malu
featured_reviews.review_text:
We were looking to buy wedding attire for my father under quite challenging circumstances. The wedding was just 2–3 days away, we were visiting from Jaysingpur (Kolhapur), my father wears an XL size, and we had only one single day to shop for him before he had to leave for another city due to urgent work.

We had purchased outfits from Kalki about 4–5 years ago and always loved how their designs matched our taste and style. When I checked online and saw that Kalki had introduced a men’s collection as well, we didn’t think twice and headed straight to the store. We reached around 12:15 pm, where Mr. Rizwan, the sales executive, warmly greeted us and patiently understood our requirements. He showed us a few outfits, one of which we immediately liked. My father tried it on, and some fitting alterations were required.

When we explained our tight timeline, the stylist Mr. Loken, who had been attentively observing and listening, immediately understood the urgency. With calm confidence, he simply said, “I’ll give it to you by 8 pm.” That one sentence brought immense relief to us.

We are genuinely grateful to Mr. Loken and Mr. Rizwan for their kindness, professionalism, and willingness to go the extra mile. Despite the time constraints, they ensured the outfit was perfectly altered and delivered on the very same day. Experiences like these truly set Kalki apart — not just for their designs, but for the people who stand behind them.

Thank you for making a stressful situation so smooth and memorable. 🙏

featured_reviews.name: Soham D
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently purchased two traditional outfits, a Jodhpuri suit and a kurta set from Kalki Fashion Santacruz, and the entire experience felt genuinely smooth and well-guided from start to finish.

What truly stood out was the assistance from Shiva. He didn’t just show options mechanically, he actually understood my preferences and guided me thoughtfully through different styles, fits, and color combinations. That kind of attention made a noticeable difference, especially when choosing something as detail-heavy as traditional wear. Overall, the service combined with product quality made the experience genuinely satisfying. If you’re looking for well-crafted ethnic wear with proper guidance rather than just a sales push, this store is definitely worth considering.

featured_reviews.name: Gauravi Thakur Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kalki Santacruz staff is seriously ruining the brand’s image with their poor service and unprofessional behavior.
I purchased a saree with a ready blouse in a hurry and, unfortunately, did not check the product thoroughly before payment. After payment and alterations, I noticed the blouse was damaged, with stitches coming out. Due to time constraints, I took it after being assured by the staff that it would be fixed properly if I brought it back.
I returned the blouse for fixing on 12/11/2025. Later, I called to check if it was ready and was informed that it was. However, when I went to collect it on 27/11/2025, the blouse was in an even worse condition—not only was the stitching poorly done, but the embroidery/work at the back was also coming apart.
When I raised this issue, the staff, including the store manager and tailor, behaved rudely but assured me again that it would be fixed.
On Sunday, 21st December, I contacted the store to check the status. They told me their system showed the blouse as “fixed,” which was clearly false, as they had already called me earlier to collect it when it was not ready. I requested them to reconfirm and get back to me.
Since then, there has been no response, despite multiple attempts to contact the store. The lack of accountability and communication is extremely frustrating.
This experience has been a complete waste of money, time, and trust. For a brand like Kalki, this level of service is unacceptable.
I strongly advise others to think twice before buying from this store

Images are of 27/11/2025 when they had called me to collect my ready blouse

featured_reviews.name: Shruti Tekwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
This was the most frustrating experiences I had during my trip to India. My family and I bought 7 items from this store on the condition that 2 items would be tailored, ready, and delivered to our hotel by a certain time the next day so we would have enough time to make it to the airport for our flight. When I was looking at clothes, there were about 6 people swarming around me and the store manager kept interrupting the salesperson with all the wrong advice regarding what to show me. He was extremely pushy.
The next day my Dad called to follow up regarding the delivery since it wasn’t at the hotel as promised and he was told it would be delivered at 9pm (2 hours after our flight was scheduled to depart). He reminded them of their promise and they said they would see what they could do. We stopped at the store on the way to the airport and they said it would be 5 minutes. They repeated this about 20 times. One of the Saree blouses they stitched was awful and I am not able to wear it. Even after trying things on and expressing urgency of time, they took the outfits to the back room and disappeared with them. I kept stressing the time crunch but they kept saying 5 minutes. It took a total of 49 minutes for them to finally bring the items from the back AFTER I tried them on (supposedly they were ironing and packaging them). I kept getting told “Sorry Ma’am” but this store has terrible customer service and I wouldn’t waste my time. The manager who tailed and harassed me during the time of purchase looked right through my family and me the next day when it came to picking up the goods they were supposed to deliver, as if he didn’t know us. I would spend my time and money on “Seasons” or “Friendship” instead.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I'm so glad I live close by this Santacruz Market! Located conveniently next to Santacruz station, with autos easily available, it's a shopper's paradise!

You'll find everything you need here, from daily essentials to trendy clothing. The food options are amazing, with a variety of delicious choices to satisfy your cravings.

But the highlight is the Thursday market - it's a MUST-VISIT for unbeatable deals! You'll find fashionable clothing at unbelievable prices, making it a treasure trove for bargain hunters.

What's more, the market is always up-to-date with the latest fashion trends, ensuring you stay stylish and on-point.

Overall, Santacruz Market is a hidden gem that deserves more recognition. Do yourself a favor and explore this incredible shopping destination!
